patchOperation.description:
Canonical PATCH entry for partial updates. Omitted scalar fields and relation arrays are preserved. Explicit relation arrays replace those relations; an empty array clears them. An empty JSON object is a no-op for an otherwise valid existing post. Existing content/media validation and author-only permissions are unchanged; this change introduces a canonical HTTP method without changing the update service.
No query parameters are read. Authenticated author only; deleted/missing post => 40401, another author => 42201. Empty final non-repost content without media, invalid visibility/language, invalid body/path, unusable attachments => 40001. Relationship arrays replace existing values when present; unknown keys and unsupported creation-only reference fields are ignored. Success data is complete serialized post, not a diff. Returning the updated post can also yield 40401 if it is no longer visible, or author lookup fails. Authentication accepts bearer token or access_token cookie according to auth middleware; all successful responses have meta=null (no pagination). Framework/Oracle/Redis failures can produce 5xx; source audit is not runtime acceptance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Converted with Number and required >0 by v2RouterNumber; integer-only validation is not implemented. Numeric strings including positive fractions/scientific notation are accepted if representable.

400.description: 40001: invalid path/body, visibility/language, empty final non-repost or unusable attachment. V2 error metadata is nested in framework error data, rather than a flat success envelope.

401.description: 40101: missing/invalid/revoked/expired access credential. V2 error metadata is nested in framework error data, rather than a flat success envelope.

404.description: 40401: post deleted/missing/not visible after update or author missing. V2 error metadata is nested in framework error data, rather than a flat success envelope.

422.description: 42201: only post author may update. V2 error metadata is nested in framework error data, rather than a flat success envelope.

default.description: Framework/Oracle/Redis failure or content negotiation; not assigned invented service-specific error codes. Sensitive production failures may omit data.

legacyPutOperation.summary: Partially update an owned post (legacy PUT alias)

evidence.notes: PATCH contains the previous PUT handler; PUT re-exports that exact handler. Both call unchanged v2UpdatePost/v2ReadUpdatePostPayload. Nuxt and Flutter updatePost alone switch to PATCH. Ten isolated Node tests execute real routes/input parsing/update service plus the Nuxt API wrapper without opening sockets, starting services, or accessing Oracle/Redis. The final post reload/Oracle/cache/logging/notification boundaries are stubbed, so this is not a database or end-to-end acceptance claim. Flutter change is statically reviewed; no Dart/Flutter SDK was run.
